review.title: Closure review
review.loadFailed: Could not load the review details.
review.photoFailed: That photograph could not be read.
review.submitHint: Submitting does not close the action. A reviewer closes it.
review.keptPhotosHint: If you attach no new photograph, the photographs already submitted are kept. New photographs replace them.
review.selfBlocked: You submitted this action, so another reviewer has to decide it.
review.requestLink: Ask for a documented exception instead
review.requestReasonLabel: Reason for closing without a verified fix
review.requestHint: This does not close the action. A different authorised person approves or refuses the request. Your name, the time and this reason are kept permanently with the action.
review.decideHint: Approving closes the action as a documented exception, without a verified fix. Your name and the time are kept permanently.
review.exceptionSelfBlocked: You asked for this exception or submitted this action, so another authorised person has to decide it.
review.waitingReviewer: This action is waiting for a reviewer to approve the closure or return it.
review.waitingException: An exception has been requested. It is waiting for an authorised person to approve or refuse it.
review.waitingWorker: This action is with the person it is assigned to. There is nothing for you to do here.

done.submitted: Submitted. A reviewer will approve the closure or return it.
done.returned: Returned to the worker for correction.
done.approved: Closure approved. The action is closed.
done.exceptionRequested: Exception requested. The action stays open until a different authorised person decides.
done.exceptionApproved: Exception approved. The action is closed as a documented exception.
done.exceptionRefused: Exception refused. The action is back with the worker.

fault.title: Recorded faults ({count})
fault.loadFailed: Could not load the faults on this checklist.
fault.closeHint: Each fault is closed through its corrective action, by a reviewed fix or a documented exception.
fault.intro: This checklist cannot be approved while a fault is recorded. You can acknowledge it instead: the fault stays as written, the sheet is locked, and it counts as compliant only when every fault is resolved or has a documented exception.
fault.bothSteps: Your signature is recorded on both signing steps.
fault.ackFailed: The checklist could not be acknowledged.
fault.done: Acknowledged. The fault stays on record and the checklist needs action until it is resolved.
fault.actionRequiredHint: This checklist was signed with a fault still open. The fault and its corrective action stay on record until the fault is resolved or covered by a documented exception.

settings.title: Who reviews and closes actions
settings.saved: Saved. The new rules apply from the next review.
settings.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
settings.reviewers: Roles that review and close corrective actions
settings.reviewersHint: Role names separated by commas, exactly as they appear in Access Control.
settings.exceptions: Roles that may approve or refuse a requested exception
settings.exceptionsHint: The person who asked for an exception can never decide it, whatever their role.
settings.finalSigners: Extra roles that give the final checklist signature
settings.finalSignersHint: Added to the fixed final signers. Each person still signs only within their own sites.
settings.photos: Photographs required with a completion (0 to 6)
settings.directClose: Reviewers may still close an action directly from the status list (recorded in the history)
settings.selfReview: A reviewer may approve a completion they submitted themselves (never applies to exceptions)
settings.selfAck: A signer may acknowledge a checklist they submitted themselves

msg.exceptionWaiting: Exception requested, waiting for a decision
msg.describe: Describe what was done to complete this action.
msg.onePhoto: Attach at least one photograph as completion evidence.
msg.somePhotos: Attach the required photographs as completion evidence.
msg.sayCorrected: Say what has to be corrected before returning the action.
msg.exceptionReasonShort: An exception needs a written reason of at least 10 characters.
msg.sayRefused: Say why the exception is refused.
msg.notOn: Closure review is not switched on for this system yet.
msg.selfReview: You submitted this action, so another reviewer has to decide it.
msg.selfClose: You submitted this action, so another reviewer has to close it.
msg.selfExceptionAsked: You asked for this exception, so another authorised person has to decide it.
msg.selfExceptionSubmitted: You submitted this action, so another authorised person has to decide its exception.
msg.onlyAssigneeUpdate: Only the person this action is assigned to can update it.
msg.onlyAssigneeSubmit: Only the person this action is assigned to can submit it for review.
msg.notReviewerRole: Your role is not set up to review corrective actions in this company.
msg.notExceptionRole: Your role is not authorised to decide an exception.
msg.alreadySubmitted: This action has already been submitted and is waiting for review.
msg.nothingSubmitted: Nothing has been submitted for review on this action yet.
msg.exceptionAlready: An exception has already been requested on this action and is waiting for a decision.
msg.noException: No exception has been requested on this action.
msg.outsideScope: That action does not exist or is outside your company, country or sites.
msg.needsReviewer: Closing an action needs a reviewer. Submit your completion evidence and a reviewer will close it.
msg.notWaitingSignature: This checklist is not waiting for a signature.
msg.policyRouted: This checklist is routed through an approval policy. Decide it in the approval queue.
msg.noFault: This checklist has no recorded fault. Approve it in the normal way.
msg.selfAck: You submitted this checklist, so another signer has to acknowledge it.
msg.supervisorFirst: Give the supervisor signature first. The final signer then acknowledges the fault.
msg.finalSignerOnly: Only a final signer can acknowledge this checklist.
msg.noSignPermission: You do not have permission to sign this checklist.
msg.signatureRequired: A signature is required to acknowledge this checklist.
msg.notConfirmed: The server did not confirm the acknowledgement. Refresh before retrying.
msg.sheetOutsideScope: That checklist does not exist or is outside your company, country or sites.
msg.notPhoto: That file is not a photograph.
msg.exceptionPendingClose: An exception has been requested on this action. Approve or refuse the exception first.
